statusNote: Storyboard-level keyframes generated from the pack shot prompts verbatim; NOT final picture. keyframes.framing: Wide shot of an ancient rain-green forest clearing: a shallow trickle winds between mossy trunks and exposed roots while clusters of pale fungi dot the grass along the water's course.
keyframes.knownDefects: The prompt frames an empty environment shot, but a lone figure in a conical hat and green cloak stands center-right (unnamed traveler, not an enemy, so no canon conflict, but an added figure). Otherwise faithful: fungi path, trickle, no enemies, no text.

keyframes.framing: Diagonal close view of a massive sloped bark surface with four glowing cyan channels carved into it carrying bright abstract stroke patterns, a dark leaf form lying across the right-hand channels, and Ly An standing small at frame left looking at them.
keyframes.knownDefects: The four grooves render as wide, strongly luminous cyan canals, far brighter and larger than the prompt's shallow grooves brightening gently; Ly An appears in frame although the prompt is a pure bark/water detail shot; the leaf shadow is rendered as an actual oversized leaf lying on the bark rather than only a passing shadow. The in-groove strokes stay abstract and unreadable, as required.

keyframes.framing: Medium shot of Ly An kneeling beside a moss-covered trunk in the forest, holding a registry slip in her raised hand while a blank copied slip lies on the moss beside the bark, her brown mail satchel at her hip.
keyframes.knownDefects: Setting drift: a tiled-roof structure with hanging signboards stands at frame left (not in the prompt), and its signboards carry glyph-like marks that approach lettering (illegible, but borderline against the no-readable-writing rule). She holds the slip up reading it instead of laying it beside the bark — the laid slip is the blank one, so the prompt's action is only half-present. Her satchel bears a small envelope pictogram. Lighting is warm daylight, drifting from the deep-green gloom of S01/S02. Minor continuity nit: her carry-gear differs between S02 (woven backpack) and S03 (leather satchel), though hair (dark topknot) and blue courier dress read as the same person.

notes: 3 separate 16:9 keyframes, one per shot, 640x360 each.
